tei:div.tei:p: 521) ༄༅/ tshes bcu la rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs bskang 'don 'grigs ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa= dkon mchog rjes dran/ ngan 'gro'i lam ni=byang chub sems kyi phan yon dran/ dkon mchog= nas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i= bar/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= bzhugs gsol/ phyogs dus kun nas= tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ bla ma mnyam med= dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ skyes bu khyu mchog= sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang gi dang por= sku gdung cha brgyad mdzad la= 'di ltar stan pa'i bdag po= 'phags pa 'jam dpal= bzang spyod phyag 'tshal/ spyod 'jug gi rin chen sems de= badz+ra bhu mi= maṇ+ḍal so bdun/ sa bzhi= bdun ma/ stong gsum 'jig rten= sku gsum maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs= tshig bcad gnyis/ me tog dam pa= bzang spyod mchod pa/ bla ma rgyal ba= spyod 'jug lus dbul/ bla ma rdo rje= jo bshags dang ltung bshags/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= bzang spyod kyi yan lag phyi ma rnams/ ma nam mkha'= tshad med bzhi/ lus dang de bzhin= gzhi gsum gtong ba/ phyogs bcu na= dgongs su gsol ba gsum gyis sad par byas/ byang chub snying por= skyabs su 'gro ba gsum gyis gzhi bca'/ ji ltar sngon gyi= dngos gzhi brjod pa gsum gyis dam bcas pa'i mjug deng dus bdag tshe= rang gzhan dga' ba bsgom/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ 'gro don= sogs smon lam gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa= nas/ oṃ a mo gha= tshul khrims rnam dag gzungs/ bdag sogs= nas/ rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog zhes smon lam gdab/ hūm̐: o rgyan= tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ spros bral chos dbyings= sku gsum gsol 'debs/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ gzhung gi brgyud 'debs/ rnam kun mchog ldan= mthar/ dung chen/ thing*/ sil/ rkang*/ 522) ḍā/ bzhag rol/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

na mo: bdag dang mtha' yas= lan gsum/ hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor= lan gsum/ ho chu las chu bur= lan gsum/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ badz+ra ma hā shṝ= sogs/ dkar gtor mthar/ zhi rol/ dkar/ bgegs gtor mthar/ dung chen/ thing*/ sil/ sum gnyis/ hrīḥ snod bcud sprul pa'i= rdo rjes gzhom/ (Musical notes and signs here) mthar/ dung chen/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa= 'bebs mgor/ rgya/ dung chen/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: spros bral= mthar/ rgya/ dung chen/ brgyud gsum rol mo/ de'i nangabashugs pa/ g.yab dar/ mthar/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ bzhag rol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: snang srid= lhug 'don/ shab+da la/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ bcad/ dung chen ṇir bkug nas sbrel/ sarba pañtsa= lan gsum/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: ma bcos= spyan 'dren mgor/ rkang bzhi/ rgya/ dung*/ g.yab/ sum gnyis/ mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ g.yab/ ḍā/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: thabs kyis= mchod pa'i mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: ma bcos= bstod pa mthar/ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ bsnyen dmigs/lhug sid+dhi/ sum brgya/ gab byang*/ snang srid zil gnon= ma hā gu ru= brgya/ thugs ka'i= 523) hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bsnyen/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying*/ mchod phreng zhi rol lnga la/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ las byang mchod pa/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ bstod pa/ yig brgya/ gsol ka tshang bar bsag sde brgyad mchod pa mthar/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs= yid la 'dod pa= rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ sil/ bzhag na raka skong bshags/ zhi rol bzhi la/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ mar me'i smon lam mthar/ tshogs zhus/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: bdag gi= rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: 'og min= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum= rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: bdag gi= 'jam rol/ bzhag rol la kha 'bud med/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud=

khyad par bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil= (Musical notes and signs here) rkang lnga/ dung chen/ dgu klog nang*/ rkang gcig (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ hūm̐: ma rig= phaṭaḥ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ 'jam rol bzhag skong bshags/ na moḥ bde gshegs= lhug nam mdzod/ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ rgya/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ āḥ rang byung= sa la skyol: tshogs rdzas 'dod yon= grangs gsog mdor na rab 'byams= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ tshogs drang ba/ lan/ bdag lus= bsam lhun/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= lhag zhus/ lhag ma byin rlabs yum bkar bris pa ltar/ dung chen/ thing gcig sil/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i= dung*/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ gtor 'gugs nas/ 524) bkra shis stsol/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ rkang gsum/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐:bzhengs shig= dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: sngon tshe= dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: dpal gyi= rgya/ dung*/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin= dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ dung chen ṇir sbrel/ las byang mchod pa/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ zhi rol/ las byang bstod pa/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i= yig brgya/ dngos grub/ hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor= rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ zhi rol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= hoḥ chu las chu bur= rjes thob= hoḥ dus gsum= lan gsum/ hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gcig thing gsum/ sil/ rkang gsum/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ bsod nams 'di yis= bzang spyod man spyi ltar ro// dge'o//
